name: Material standard: BS 8888 / BS 1192
summary: How materials draw in cuts, plans and facades after BS 8888, BS 1192: Lapin's built-in „BS 8888 / BS 1192” standard as a pack (indicative).
description: Brickwork in 45° lines, blockwork in wider 45° lines with dashes between, stone crossed by dashes; concrete speckled, reinforced concrete over 45° lines; quilt insulation as loops, rigid insulation crosshatched; sawn timber grain; steel paired lines, filled solid from 1:50; facing brick 215 × 65. Indicative, drawn by Lapin from the general principles of the norm, not copied from it: check it against the standard your drawings must follow. Installed, it is added to the open project with „Add to this project” and applied from Manage → Drawing standards → Materials. Country: GB; norm: BS 8888, BS 1192.

items: 34 rules (cut, plan and facade graphics by the material's name)
